title: English Conversation 35:  A Change of Plans
content: 1. to not feel like doing something: to not want to do something - I don't feel like working today. - She doesn't feel like going to the park today. She wants to stay home. 2. to change one's mind: to decide to do something different than what one originally decided to do - I was going to visit Japan, but then I changed my mind. Now, I am going to visit China. - I was going to buy the blue car, but I changed my mind and I got the red car. 3. at the last minute: right before a deadline or due date - He always waits to the last minute to do this work. - We finished at the last minute.
